capabilities: Read EPUB, FB2 and PDF books with paged or scrolling layouts
Highlight passages in six colours and turn them into notes with backlinks to the book
Store reading progress as vault files so it syncs across devices
Ask AI about passages or get spoiler-free recaps of recent pages
Read books aloud with an AI voice
extras: Core reading works fully offline with no telemetry; the AI voice and passage-analysis features use a paid Elton AI key topped up through Prodamus, and AI answers can alternatively use OpenRouter, OpenAI or local Ollama/LM Studio.
problem: Obsidian cannot open e-book formats, so reading and annotating books means switching to a separate reader app and losing the link to your notes.
